variant_definitions.A: Reduced current three-lane / score / fixed-checkpoint ordering adapter, NOT production C#
variant_definitions.B: A + existing-style FutureResourceValue consumed in heuristic and same setup lane
variant_definitions.C: A + one conditional setup representative from current visible toy guard; same width

cost_model.unit_warning: synthetic work unit, NOT C# node, byte, time or calibrated speed

fixtures.name: F01_energy_cycle2
fixtures.note: Recurring-energy investment; synthetic consumer pays on the second completed cycle.

fixtures.name: F02_scaling_cycle3
fixtures.note: Scaling first use is weak; repeats pay by cycle three.

fixtures.name: F03_no_consumer
fixtures.note: A future resource is not a usable payoff; C must not create a seat.

fixtures.name: F04_late_self_risk
fixtures.note: Later known excess must beat attractive output; no first-action blacklist.

fixtures.name: F05_gain_then_spend
fixtures.note: Raw current stars are not FutureResourceValue; legality checked before spend.

fixtures.name: F06_star_events_block
fixtures.note: One positive gain/spend event gives fixed BH damage; spend amount gives block.

fixtures.name: F07_dark_growth_evoke
fixtures.note: Existing Dark passive feature does not encode stored evoke amount.

fixtures.name: F08_good_bad_suffix
fixtures.note: One engine first action, separate safe and harmful suffixes.

fixtures.name: F09_immediate_control
fixtures.note: Immediate payoff already enters offense; no extra C protection.

fixtures.name: F10_seat_opportunity_cost
fixtures.note: Negative control: replaced existing setup seat is actually better later.

fixtures.name: F11_parent_cap
fixtures.note: The route disappears before Beam; B/C after Beam cannot restore it.

fixtures.name: F12_budget_cutoff
fixtures.note: Small identical total work caps, including feature reads and replay.

fixtures.name: F13_payoff_cycle6
fixtures.note: Five-cycle bridge within seven enemy cycles; prediction not safety proof.

fixtures.name: F14_outside_cycle7
fixtures.note: At horizon no next player start; no in-window consumer.

fixtures.name: F15_peer_only_resource
fixtures.note: Toy engine can progress conditionally; local C may not claim peer-owned opportunity.

fixtures.name: F16_external_choice
fixtures.note: No fake default choice; explicitly stop at external-player boundary.

fixtures.name: F17_recurring_power_no_future_field
fixtures.note: Recurring engine may have only generic persistent stacks, not EnergyNextTurnPower.

scope_notes: Main-tree RNG is a deterministic state counter; random combat effects are not modeled.
No 3/4-player combat, potion engine, production memory or wall-clock quality is tested.
Comparator tiebreak improvement is not counted as a realized combat improvement.
